mapper.textPrompt:
Return EXACT JSON object with ALL field VALUES as STRINGS, including hashtags. hashtags MUST be ONE space-separated STRING such as "#MedicalTravel #PatientQuestions #PlacidWay", NEVER an array. Example shape: {"title":"TITLE","summary":"A neutral summary","hook":"...","value1":"...","value2":"...","cta":"Listen to the episode.","hashtags":"#MedicalTravel #PatientQuestions #PlacidWay","evidence1":"exact source phrase","evidence2":"exact source phrase"}. Do not include any keys not specified. Create a neutral English social caption describing topics covered in this PlacidWay Pulse podcast episode. Avoid any medical claims, treatment recommendations, safety promises, prices or unsupported facts. Return ONLY valid JSON keys title,summary,hook,value1,value2,cta,hashtags,evidence1,evidence2. Use exact TITLE as title. cta must be 'Listen to the episode.'. 3-5 hashtags. evidence1/evidence2 must quote exact snippets in SOURCE supporting the two topic lines. Keep caption components below 420 chars and no URL. TITLE: {{2.title}} SOURCE: {{substring(5.text; 0; 17500)}}
STRICT STYLE: hook MUST start exactly 'In this PlacidWay episode:'. Both value1 and value2 MUST start 'The episode discusses ' and describe only topic names or interview questions, never medical mechanisms, advice, biological effects, benefits or risks. Use hashtags exactly '#PlacidWay #MedicalTravel #Podcast'. Never address the reader's health or symptoms. Do not repeat efficacy or safety assertions, even when the source makes them.
